content:
Another streaming service has hiked its prices. Peacock has raised all three subscription tiers, with increases of up to $3 per month or $30 per year.

Following Peacock's latest price hike, the Premium Plus monthly subscription now costs $20. However, the bundled discount offer with Apple remains unchanged for now.

Peacock is currently raising prices by $3 per month

The streaming platform stated: "This price adjustment enables Peacock to continue delivering the best experience for viewers, maintaining market competitiveness, and providing unique content for all types of audiences."

Under Peacock's new pricing, the entry-level Select plan now costs $8.99 per month or $89.99 per year, up from $7.99 and $79.99 respectively.

Peacock Premium has increased from $10.99 to $12.99 per month, with the annual fee rising from $109.99 to $129.99.

Peacock Premium Plus, which offers near-ad-free viewing with download support, now costs $19.99 per month or $199.99 per year, up from the previous $16.99 monthly and $169.99 annual fees.

Across the entire product line, Peacock Premium sees the largest increase at approximately 18%. The annual plan works out to roughly 10 months at the new monthly price, excluding any limited-time offers.

The new pricing takes effect today (August 18) and applies to new and returning subscribers.

Existing subscribers will be charged at the new rate starting from their first billing date on or after September 17. Current annual plans and ongoing promotional offers will remain at their existing prices until they expire.

Two years ago, Premium was adjusted to $7.99 per month, while Premium Plus was set at $13.99. Peacock later introduced Select while continuing to raise prices on its two main tiers. The Premium plan alone has seen an additional $5 monthly increase in just over two years.

Apple TV bundle offer remains unchanged for now

One unanswered question concerns the bundle offer between Apple TV and Peacock.

Apple still lists Apple TV with Peacock Premium at $14.99 per month, and with Premium Plus at $19.99 per month. As we noted in April, compared with the $12.99 monthly fee for Apple TV on its own, this means Peacock effectively costs just an extra $2 or $7.

For now, Apple's bundle offer page still shows both prices unchanged.

That said, subscribers continue to face a wave of price hikes across entertainment services. Apple also joined the price increase wave last month, raising prices for Apple Music and Apple One.
